title: Compatible local quotient maps identify a fixed coherent source's completion with N.
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ a coherent module and $N$ a coherent formal module for $J$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $\delta:N\to H^\wedge$. Let $(U_i)$ be a family of open subschemes. Fix a coherent global $F$ and $a:F\to H$. Supply coherent $F_i$, identifications $e_i:F|_{U_i}\cong F_i$, and $\beta_i:N|_{U_i}\cong F_i^\wedge$. Supply maps $p_{i,n}:F|_{U_i}\to N_n|_{U_i}$ which, under the open-subscheme/over-site equivalence, equal $e_i\pi_{F_i,n}\beta_{i,n}^{-1}$. Assume these maps agree on every open in a pairwise intersection and $p_{i,n}\delta_n=a|_{U_i}\pi_{H,n}|_{U_i}$. Then there are system isomorphisms $\epsilon_i:N|_{U_i}\cong F^\wedge|_{U_i}$ whose hom components agree on every contained open and satisfy $\delta_n|_{U_i}=\epsilon_{i,n}a^\wedge_n|_{U_i}$.

proof.text: Use coherence of F on the Noetherian scheme to obtain quasi-coherence. Compose the inverse of restrictionCompletionIso with formalCompletionFunctor.mapIso(ei) and the inverse of beta_i. This constructs the completion-to-N isomorphism on the open subscheme, with naturality in the inverse-system index already built in.

Whisker the equivalence between over-site modules and modules on the open subscheme, conjugating by overFunctorEquiv and associators. Full faithfulness gives the preimage isomorphism b_i on the over-site. Map its components through that equivalence; restrictionQuotientIso_pi and quotientMap_pi, combined with hpi, prove q_F restricted to U_i followed by b_i equals pi_i.

Quotient projections are cokernel epimorphisms, and restriction to an open preserves epimorphisms. On each common open W, transport b_i and b_j to the over-site of W and cancel the restricted quotient projection. The hypothesis hcompat gives equality on every object of that site; sheaf-module extensionality gives equality of the transported arrows. Evaluation at W and equality of inverses of isomorphisms prove overlap compatibility for epsilon_i = b_i inverse.

For the factorization of delta, first cancel the isomorphism b_i and then the restricted quotient epimorphism. Its composite with b_i is pi_i, so hdelta reduces the claim to quotientMap_pi for a. This proves the required equality. Empty index families have no obligations; for J=0 all positive-power quotient projections are isomorphisms, and for J=1 the local quotients and the corresponding restricted components of N are zero.

theorem compatible_quotient_formal_comparisons
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H) (a : F ⟶ H)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (Fi : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (ei : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj F.obj ≅ (Fi i).obj)
    (βi : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) (Fi i).obj)
    (pi : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), F.obj.over (U i) ⟶ (N.obj.obj n).over (U i))
    (hpi : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ),
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (pi i n) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app (N.obj.obj n) =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app F.obj ≫ (ei i).hom ≫
        formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap (U i).ι) (n.unop + 1) (Fi i).obj ≫
          (βi i).inv.app n)
    (hcompat : ∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
      (pi i n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) =
        (pi j n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj))))
    (hδ : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), pi i n ≫ (δ.hom.app n).over (U i) =
      a.hom.over (U i) ≫ (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n.unop + 1) H.obj).over (U i)) :
    ∃ ε : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (U i) ≅
        ((completion X J).obj F).obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (U i),
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
        ((ε i).hom.app n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) =
          ((ε j).hom.app n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i : ι), (δ.hom.app n).over (U i) =
        (ε i).hom.app n ≫ (((completion X J).map a).hom.app n).over (U i))
